newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia bus plunges into ravine injuring 29.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia bus plunges into ravine injuring 29.

text.p: A bus plunged down a ravine in the Malaysian hilltop resort of Genting Highlands injuring all 29 people on board, a traffic official said on Tuesday.
The bus ran off a winding road at 11.30 p.m. (1430 GMT) on Monday, the national Bernama news agency said, quoting a spokesman for Resorts World Bhd, the operator of the resort.
Genting Highlands is nearly 6,000 feet (1,800 metres) above sea level about 60 km (40 miles) from the capital, Kuala Lumpur.
Federal traffic chief Dell Akhbar Khan told Reuters that eight of the injured were in serious condition after the accident which happened in thick fog.
On July 16, a tourist bus plunged into a ravine along the Genting road, killing 17 people and injuring 15.
